title: LinkedIn Jobs - Job Descriptions & New Jobs
description: Minimal input: {"queries": ["data engineer"], "maxResultsPerSource": 3}. Cost: $0.005 per parsed page + $0.001 per delivered job (or $0.004/job with includeDetails=true). Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options, not input. Unchanged or filtered pages are billed.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Search keywords, for example ["data engineer"]. Up to 20 queries. Each query has independent page and delivered-result limits. No separate source account or API key required.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Maximum delivered rows per source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum matching rows per search after filters and monitoring; for example 50. Default 50, maximum 1000. A ceiling, not a guarantee. Deduplicated across the run; Google IDs include domain, query and country; only the first visible result per domain is kept.

location.title: Job search location
location.description: Location passed to LinkedIn public search, for example "United States" or "London". Default United States. Source search can include nearby locations; this is not an exact city filter.

includeDetails.title: Include job descriptions
includeDetails.description: true fetches full public description, seniority, employment type, job function and industries when available. Charges $0.004 per delivered enriched job instead of $0.001 for a listing-only job. Failed descriptions are skipped with an error and no job fee. Page fees still apply.

companies.title: Company filters
companies.description: Keep company names containing any phrase, case-insensitive, for example ["Microsoft"]. Empty means all. Applied to visible search results before job billing; it does not discover a company directory.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs whose source posted_date is within this number of UTC calendar days, for example 7. Zero disables it. Missing dates do not pass an active filter. This filters inspected pages; it does not guarantee every recent job.

onlyNew.title: Only new jobs
onlyNew.description: true emits job IDs not previously delivered. First run delivers the baseline; use the same monitorKey later. Successful unchanged checks still pay page fees. Default false.

titleContains.title: Title includes any
titleContains.description: Keep titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive, for example ["engineer"]. For Zillow, title is building name or address. Empty disables it. Applied before row billing; parsed pages are still billed.

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes any
titleExcludes.description: Drop titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive, for example ["senior"]. Empty disables it. Filtered rows have no row fee; parsed pages still carry their fee.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Persistent history name, for example "daily-watch". Use 1–60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Use the same targets, filters and name for repeat runs. Keeps the latest 50,000 delivered IDs. Do not overlap runs sharing this name.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Skip exact output id values. Up to 10,000. Useful for external deduplication; excluded rows have no row fee, but parsed pages are billed.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Safety cap on parsed pages per search, for example 5. Default 5, maximum 20. Each parsed page costs $0.005, including filtered or unchanged checks. Both this cap and maxResultsPerSource apply.
